title: Correct induced EMF
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly calculate the induced electromotive force as 0.8 V using E = BLv.

title: Correct pulling force
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly calculate the magnitude of the pulling force as 0.8 N.

title: Correct heat generated
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly calculate the heat generated as 0.32 J.

title: Force from Ampere's law
description: Important Criteria: The response must correctly relate the pulling force to the magnetic force using F = BIL.

title: Time for traversal
description: Important Criteria: The response must correctly determine the time the coil spends in the field, using t = 2L/v or equivalent reasoning.

title: Energy conservation reasoning
description: Optional Criteria: The response may note that the work done by the pulling force equals the heat generated.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The response should show consistent use of SI units (Tesla, meters, seconds, Ohms).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student confuses the sign/direction of induced EMF or current, though magnitude is primary.

title: Incorrect active length
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student uses an incorrect length (e.g., perimeter or area) in the motional EMF formula E = BLv.
